statement: SpaceX ended Q2 2026 with 1.4 gigawatts of nameplate compute, up from 1.0 GW in Q1 2026 and 400 MW a year earlier, and guides to over 2 GW by year-end 2026.
why: Installed compute more than tripled year over year at a single buyer, which is direct evidence of the demand pulling GPU shipments through.

impact.mechanism: Nameplate compute growth from 400 MW to 1.4 GW in a year requires proportional accelerator, power, and cooling procurement.

evidence.excerpt: We ended the second quarter with 1.4 gigawatts of nameplate compute up from one gigawatt in Q1 and 400 megawatts a year earlier. We expect to end this year at over two gigawatts of compute capacity.

confidence.basis: CFO figures relayed in a secondary transcript rather than a filing.
